pamphlet_excerpts: Victim Becomes Colder: As the victim becomes colder, however, the shivering will stop.
Other symptoms Include: Other symptoms may include irritability, disorientation, sleepiness, incoherence, and the inability to think clearly or rationally.
Cover Head Warm: Cover the head with a warm hat or other covering, and offer hot drinks.
Minor Injuries Require: Minor injuries usually require little attention other than cleansing with soap, water, and disinfectant.
step_by_step_procedure: Leave Them Heal: Leave them to heal inthe air, or cover them lightly with a dry, sterile dressing.
Cut Serious Bleeding: Unless a cut is serious, bleeding probably will stop on its own or withslight pressure on the wound.
Bleeding Does Not: If the bleeding does not stop immediately, apply direct and firm pressure to the wound with a sterile dressing or compress; raise the injured limb.
Disinfect Wound Then: Clean and disinfect the wound, then cover with a sterile bandage.

pamphlet_excerpts: Surveying Involves Measuring: Surveying involves measuring horizontal and vertical distancesand angles.
Involves Extensive: It also involves extensive computation (much ofwhich is done with a computer) and map drawing (much ofwhich is done with a computer-controlled printer.
Global Positioning System: The Global Positioning System (GPS) uses artificial Earthsatellites and portable computers equipped with receivers.
GPSreceivers Process Signals: GPSreceivers process signals from the satellites to calculate location.
step_by_step_procedure: Allows Position Latitude: This allows you to find your position (latitude, longitude, andelevation) almost anywhere on Earth, quickly and accurately, in almost any.
GPS Latitude Longitude: Using GPS, latitude and longitude canbe measured directly, without having to measure distancesand angles between points.
Especially Useful Thenearest: This is especially useful when thenearest survey monuments are far away.
Badgecounselor Demonstrate: Your merit badgecounselor might be able to demonstrate surveying using GPS.
